posts.text: mint – 12 Aug 26 Mobile bills set to rise as Airtel scraps ₹299 entry-level plan | Mint In an indirect tariff hike, the operator pushes subscribers to a minimum ₹349 monthly recharge to drive Arpu growth, raising the base price for daily data by nearly 17%.
